method: Targeted evaluator counterexample tests, logged out, no contact/vehicle identifiers/form submissions. No bulk crawl. Browser session may retain public city preferences from previous evaluator work.
timing: No performance benchmark or customer completion-time measurement.

tests.question: Does the advertised browser API support device/viewport control?
tests.counterexample_criterion: A real mobile viewport can be set and verified; otherwise explicitly not tested.

tests.question: Is finance preview universally blocked until contact, or does access vary for a BEV product?
tests.counterexample_criterion: A selected bZ4X scenario produces pre-contact illustration with explicit assumptions.

tests.question: Does workshop selection support the BEV model before the identifier boundary?
tests.counterexample_criterion: bZ4X and hybrid selections can be compared without plate or personal details; no downstream capability inference.

tests.question: Are the prior hybrid free-service terms universal across BEV and conventional models?
tests.counterexample_criterion: Different supported model/variant rows or programme conditions demonstrate job-specific access and limits.

tests.question: Can a customer find model-specific battery/warranty terms before contact?
tests.counterexample_criterion: An actual public product journey exposes a bounded warranty/maintenance statement, with source date and scope.

tests.question: Does BEV test-drive availability or confirmation differ from the observed hybrid route?
tests.counterexample_criterion: Accessible bZ4X route and model/branch/FAQ conditions are recorded; no appointment submitted.

tests.question: Does one more plausible Indonesian search phrase falsify the apparent English-query discovery gap?
tests.counterexample_criterion: A programme/eligibility result is discoverable through the site search; a null local result is not sitewide absence.

tests.question: Does a named branch page expose model/job capability beyond the coarse category filter?
tests.counterexample_criterion: A named branch explicitly supports a defined EV service job or links to scope details; hours alone are not capacity proof.
